mentions.name: Fresh Cards
mentions.description: Update/rewrite of the Fresh Cards flashcards app that improves all aspects of the product. It uses a playlist metaphor: the flashcard database is a library that can be sorted in different ways, and hitting Play starts a review session that goes through cards in small batches, returning to an overview screen after each batch. A newly designed overview shows the full playlist with upcoming card contents redacted, so users see how much is left to review without being spoiled, which encourages continued reviewing.
mentions.problem: The current version of the app has many limitations, motivating a rewrite that improves all aspects, including a redesigned session overview screen that conveys progress without being overwhelming.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an update to my flashcards app, Fresh Cards. The current version has a lot of limitations, so I've been working on a rewrite that improves all aspects of the app, for nearly a year now.
